description:
Greetings from Planet VILTRUM! 

We are Four Computer Science & Informatics graduates, united by curiosity, creativity, and a passion for turning ideas into code. This time, our mission is to help Earth’s farmers face the challenges of a changing climate.

With FieldShift, we’re transforming NASA’s satellite data into smarter farming decisions one line of code, one field, and one season at a time.

No superpowers. Just code, creativity, and a mission to make a difference!
